(sec-module-symbolicutilities)=
# Module: symbolicUtilities

Rotation and kinematics functions for symbolic user functions (#3069): a selection of
exudyn.cUtilities / exudyn.rigidBodyUtilities with the same names and arguments, plus a last argument
functions, the module whose sin, cos, sqrt, ... are used. With functions=exudyn.symbolic (the default)
the arguments may be symbolic and the result is an exudyn.symbolic.Matrix or Vector, which a symbolic
user function records; with functions=numpy, math or exudyn.cMath they are numbers and the result is a
numpy array, equal to the one of cUtilities. So a user function is written once for both; for numbers
alone, exudyn.cUtilities is faster.
Arguments are sequences indexed by component: lists, numpy arrays, symbolic vectors or their slices.

- **Author**: Johannes Gerstmayr
- **Date**: 2026-10-23 (created)

(sec-symbolicutilities-skew)=
## Function: Skew

[`Skew(vector, functions = exu.symbolic)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolicUtilities.py#L50)

- **function description**: skew symmetric 3 x 3 matrix of a 3D vector, Skew(a) @ b = a x b; equals exudyn.cUtilities.Skew for a 3D vector
- **input**:
  - `vector`: 3D vector
  - `functions`: exudyn.symbolic (symbolic or numbers), numpy, math or exudyn.cMath (numbers)
- **output**: 3 x 3 matrix, symbolic for exudyn.symbolic, else as np.array

(sec-symbolicutilities-rotationvector2rotationmatrix)=
## Function: RotationVector2RotationMatrix

[`RotationVector2RotationMatrix(rotationVector, functions = exu.symbolic)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolicUtilities.py#L356)

- **function description**: rotation matrix of the rotation vector v with the angle a = |v|, I + sin(a)/a Skew(v) + 2 sin(a/2)^2/a^2 Skew(v)^2, see appendix B in [Simo1988]; below a = 1e-12 the factors are their limits 1 and 1/2, for symbolic arguments chosen by exudyn.symbolic.IfThenElse; equals exudyn.cUtilities.RotationVector2RotationMatrix
- **input**:
  - `rotationVector`: 3D rotation vector
  - `functions`: exudyn.symbolic (symbolic or numbers), numpy, math or exudyn.cMath (numbers)
- **output**: 3 x 3 rotation matrix, symbolic for exudyn.symbolic, else as np.array

(sec-symbolicutilities-rotationvector2g)=
## Function: RotationVector2G

[`RotationVector2G(rotationVector, functions = exu.symbolic)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolicUtilities.py#L386)

- **function description**: G matrix of the rotation vector as the Lie group node NodeRigidBodyRotVecLG uses it, whose velocity coordinates are the local angular velocity: the rotation matrix; equals exudyn.rigidBodyUtilities.RotationVector2G
- **input**:
  - `rotationVector`: 3D rotation vector
  - `functions`: exudyn.symbolic (symbolic or numbers), numpy, math or exudyn.cMath (numbers)
- **output**: 3 x 3 matrix G, symbolic for exudyn.symbolic, else as np.array


(sec-symbolicutilities-rotationvector2glocal)=
## Function: RotationVector2GLocal

[`RotationVector2GLocal(rotationVector, functions = exu.symbolic)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolicUtilities.py#L399)

- **function description**: local G matrix of the rotation vector as the Lie group node NodeRigidBodyRotVecLG uses it, whose velocity coordinates are the local angular velocity: the unit matrix; equals exudyn.rigidBodyUtilities.RotationVector2GLocal
- **input**:
  - `rotationVector`: 3D rotation vector
  - `functions`: exudyn.symbolic (symbolic or numbers), numpy, math or exudyn.cMath (numbers)
- **output**: 3 x 3 unit matrix, symbolic for exudyn.symbolic, else as np.array
